summary:
Implemented the window-title feature; nothing was run and nothing was committed.

Changes:
- rich/segment.py: added SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member to the ControlCode union.
- rich/control.py: added the formatter entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and the Control.title(title) classmethod with a docstring.
- rich/_windows_renderer.py: added an elif branch that reads the title from the second item and calls term.set_title(title).
- rich/console.py: added Console.set_window_title after show_cursor, gated only on is_terminal, with the spec's docstring caveats.
- CHANGELOG.md: added an Added section under Unreleased, above Fixed, with a bullet linking pull request 2200.
- Tests: test_console.py (test_set_window_title, skips the assertion on legacy Windows), test_control.py (test_control_title), test_windows_renderer.py (test_control_set_window_title, Windows-only).

Not verified: tests and mypy were not run, per the instructions. Nothing is committed.
